name: MOVE-16
description: A transport triggered machine: there is no instruction set, only moves. Every instruction moves a value from a source port (IMM, R0-R3, RES, MEM, KEYS) to a destination port, and the units act on what arrives: moving into ADD adds, into JZ jumps if zero, into CALL calls, into LCD prints, into HALT stops the clock. One opcode per source and destination pair, except moving a register to itself, MEM_TO_MEM and R3_TO_CALL.
